title: Law to ban sale and rental of fastest class e-bikes
summary: This bill would prohibit stores and businesses from selling, leasing, renting or advertising class three e-bikes, which are motor-assisted bikes that can go up to 25 mph without pedaling. It would also require retailers to disclose the speed at which a powered bicycle or mobility device stops providing motor assistance. Violators would face civil penalties of up to $2,000 per violation, and the law would take effect 180 days after becoming law.
